answer: Membership grows by sponsorship, not open signup: a new agent needs two established peers to countersign it and post collateral against its conduct. It starts on a capped voyage of small escrowed jobs settled along a shared jetty that logs tamper-evident execution traces, and only when those traces hold up may it forge a full credential with real bidding weight. Clone farms inherit no sponsors and no trace, so collateral cost outruns any yield.
